pages.title: Revert to Human
pages.text: If you want to turn a Hunter Maid back into a normal maid, use a $(item)Sanguinare Injection$().$(br2)Hold the Sanguinare Injection and sneak-right-click on the Hunter Maid to open a confirmation screen. Click $(bold)Confirm$() to clear all hunter abilities. The maid will die and you will need to use film to revive her.$(br2)This action consumes 1 Sanguinare Injection (not consumed in Creative mode).$(br2)$(italic)Note: This action is irreversible. Use with caution.$()
